column1: # RNV1_JONES_MAP_R7.tsv -- P05-S4 R7 M1 (section 3.3): window malloc map of jones and fftjones on F (dbg, no injection).
# Method: r6dnv1 driver (driver_r6b_state.cpp + inject_r6d_rnv1.cpp) linked against F dbg (drivers_r7/r6dnv1-F-dbg), NO S4FMM_INJECT
# (counting only); each run under gdb with __wrap_malloc breakpoint printing "bt 2" (gdb_malloc_lines_r7.gdb).  Logs:
# gdb_map_F_<mode>_ng<NG>_run2.log.  Positions are MEASURED by gdb backtrace (frame #1 = caller line), not inferred.
# The window (Pattern_GenerateFlowField) opens once per run; its mallocs are the four lines below after the 806 call, which
# is outside the window (pattern_get_containment_tree, before pattern_generate_flow_field) and is listed for completeness.
# All six runs: rc 0 without injection (probe in probe_map/).  Positions are identical in all six runs.
# outside the window (listed for completeness, all six runs): malloc at pattern.c:806 in pattern_get_containment_tree.
# Byte sizes are NOT recorded in this map: the gdb breakpoint prints the caller only (bt 2), so the size argument was not measured
# for jones/fftjones here.  Sizes measured in earlier rounds (nv NG9: 7168, 2048, 4096 B) are not transferred to these points.
